Several days (9 bosses with a 20 h wait each and lots of travelling)

{npc:Para Norbert}, north of the Jakundaf Desert, senses distortions in reality caused by an invisible portal. You ring the {item:Death Knell} at nine places linked to death, enter the {wiki:Brain Grounds}, the {wiki:Netherworld}, the {wiki:Barren Drift} and {wiki:Zarganash} and kill nine bosses — among them {creature:Brain Head}, {creature:Thaian} and, at the end, {creature:The Pale Worm}. You receive the {wiki:Poltergeist Outfits|Poltergeist} outfit and the achievements **Prospectre** and **Beyonder**.
Investigate a series of portals and travel to the Netherworld and Zarganash to unravel the mysteries of the realm between life and death.
Para Norbert, north of the Jakundaf Desert
Level **250** (recommended **300+**). The quest's four new areas are hunting places for level 300+.
Access to the sanctuary (Inner Sanctum) of {wiki:Lion's Rock}, obtained in the {wiki:Lion's Rock Quest} (one of the bells is rung inside it).
{wiki:Sea of Light Quest} completed (for the Thaian part, with {npc:Spectulus}).
{wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} done until you have access to {wiki:Ramoa}.
{wiki:Blood Brothers Quest} up to mission 4 (access to {wiki:Vengoth} with {npc:Harlow}).
A {item:Skull (Item)|Skull} and a {item:Grave Flower} for the potion of the first mission.

The three Netherworld minibosses must be killed **alone**. {creature:Brain Head}, {creature:Thaian} and the three Zarganash minibosses allow teams of **up to 5 players**; {creature:The Pale Worm}, **up to 10**.
given by Para Norbert; used for the three rounds of bells

to climb out of the holes (Ghostlands, Shadow Tomb, Kilmaresh Catacombs, Ramoa)
loot in the Brain Grounds; gather extra, because 25% of purifications fail
loot (uncommon) from the Netherworld minibosses, also on the Market; you hand them to The Thaian

Money for many boats, carpets and ferries (Carlin, Venore, Edron, Yalahar, Ankrahmun, Port Hope, Issavi, Liberty Bay/Goroma, Darashia, Vengoth)
{wiki:Poltergeist Outfits|Poltergeist} Outfit (base), received automatically when you kill {creature:The Pale Worm}
Achievement **Beyonder** (when you report to {npc:Para Norbert} at the end)
Access to the {wiki:Brain Grounds}, the {wiki:Netherworld}, the {wiki:Barren Drift} and {wiki:Zarganash} (hunting places for level 300+)

Boss loot: {item:Crystal Coin|Crystal Coins}, {item:Diamond|Diamonds}, {item:Moonstone|Moonstones}, {item:White Gem|White Gems}, lots of potions and, rarely, items such as {item:Phantasmal Axe}, {item:Ring of Souls}, {item:Ravenous Circlet} or {item:Fabulous Legs}
Mission Drain the Brain: after ringing the first three bells and drinking the {item:Vial with a Skull Cork}, go through the invisible portal next to {npc:Para Norbert}.
Mission Journey to the Netherworld: after the second round of bells, enter through the invisible portal east of Banuta wearing the {item:Burial Shroud}.

Thaian part: after handing the bells and the {item:Skull Coin|Skull Coins} to {npc:The Thaian}; to get in, use a {item:Small Sapphire} on the wall of the rock formation next to the tavern, north of Edron.
Final part of the quest: invisible teleport in {wiki:Vengoth}.
As you progress: Brain Head, Unaz the Mean, Irgix the Flimsy, Vok the Freakish, Thaian, The Unwelcome, The Dread Maiden, The Fear Feaster and The Pale Worm.
All with a 20-hour wait, including the final one.
Automatically, when you kill {creature:The Pale Worm}.
With the base outfit, you can collect the addons ({item:Spooky Hood} and {item:Ghost Claw}).
After completing the Feaster of Souls Quest (it is a requirement for the Soul War, which starts in Zarganash).
All the bosses have a **20-hour** cooldown, including the final one: expect it to take several days.
Make the {item:Burial Shroud} (section 6) while you are in the Brain Grounds doing the tasks of section 4: it saves you a trip.

Do not sell the {item:Skull Coin|Skull Coins} from the Netherworld minibosses (NPCs buy them for 12 000 gp): you need **3** for {npc:The Thaian}. They rarely drop; if you are short, you can buy them on the Market.
Keep all the {item:Death Toll|Death Tolls} that drop (Lost Souls and all the quest's bosses): you need **2** for each entry into the labyrinth before The Pale Worm.
Keep the {item:Soulforged Lantern|Soulforged Lanterns} that drop from {creature:The Unwelcome}, {creature:The Dread Maiden} and {creature:The Fear Feaster}: they remove the Hex at the final boss.
Always carry a {item:Rope}, a {item:Shovel} and a {item:Pick}: the quest goes through holes, tombs and mines.

For the potion: {creature:Vampire|Vampires} drop both {item:Skull (Item)|Skulls} and {item:Grave Flower|Grave Flowers}, and Grave Flowers can also be found in graveyards and crypts (often next to coffins).
1. Drain the Brain — Para Norbert and the Death Knell

First mission (Drain the Brain). Para Norbert gives you a bell that you have to ring at three places connected to death and asks you for a potion. Only with both things done can you go through the invisible portal next to him.

{npc:Para Norbert} is **north** of the {wiki:Jakundaf Desert}, the desert **south** of Kazordoon and **west** of Venore. The nearest city is **Venore**: leave the city heading **west** and walk to him (from Thais, walk **east**). To return, walk the same way back to the city.

Say {key:hi}. He tells you about the inactive portal next to him and asks whether he can count on you. Answer {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Death Knell} and the list of the three places where you have to ring it. He also asks you to drink a potion made with **bone meal** and **grave flower extract**.
If you have questions about the potion, ask him about {key:bone meal} (made by grinding a skull into powder) and {key:grave flower extract} (pick a grave flower from a grave and distil it).
Use (ring) the {item:Death Knell} at each of these three places to imbue your aura with ghostly energy. The wiki does not give a mandatory order; section 2 explains how to get to and leave each one.
At the entrance of the graveyard
Go down the south-west hole and go to the room to the west
2nd underground floor, to the east, first room to the north
Bell 2: sacrificial site beneath the Ghostlands
Bell 3: altar with skulls beneath the Dark Cathedral
2. Drain the Brain — ringing the three bells (Carlin, Ghostlands, Dark Cathedral)

Take a boat to **Carlin**: for example, in Venore with {npc:Captain Fearless} or in Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}). You arrive at Carlin harbour, next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}.
The {wiki:Carlin Graveyard} is **east** of Carlin. Go to the graveyard entrance and use the {item:Death Knell} at the coordinate spot. Then walk back to Carlin the same way.
The bell rung at the Carlin Graveyard entrance

The {wiki:Ghostlands} are **west** of Carlin, enclosed by a magic hedge. Leave Carlin heading west and go in through the Ghostlands entrance cave (coordinate below). Inside, go **south** to the **second hole** (to the south-west) and go down it.
On the floor below, go **west** to the sacrificial site room and ring the {item:Death Knell} at the coordinate spot.
First floor below the second hole
The bell rung beneath the Ghostlands

Go back to where you fell and climb up the hole with the {item:Rope}. Then leave the Ghostlands through the entrance cave and walk **east** to Carlin. At the harbour, {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you to **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}), the closest city to the Dark Cathedral.

From **Venore**, head **south-west**: the {wiki:Dark Cathedral} is south of the Venore swamp and the Outlaw Camp, **west** of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, and you can only get there by crossing the plains. Enter the ruins and go down the stairs to the **2nd underground floor**.
In the middle of the plains there may be {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} lured by other players.

On the 2nd underground floor go **east** and enter the first room to the **north**. Ring the {item:Death Knell} next to the altar, at the coordinate spot. You do not need the cathedral's levers or teleport: those are only for the 3rd floor.
The bell rung beneath the Dark Cathedral
Go up the same stairs to the surface and return to **Venore** the same way, heading **north-east** across the plains.
3. Drain the Brain — the potion (Vial with a Skull Cork)

You need a {item:Skull (Item)|Skull} and a {item:Grave Flower}. The Edron academy has a Wooden Grinder and an Alchemical Apparatus; other locations are listed below. From Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).

Use the {item:Skull (Item)|Skull} on a {item:Wooden Grinder} to get {item:Bone Meal}. There is one in the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Edron academy}: in the second tower, **two floors below** {npc:Milos}. There are also Wooden Grinders in the {wiki:Crystal Gardens}.
Using the Skull on the Wooden Grinder

Use the {item:Grave Flower} on an {item:Alchemical Apparatus} or a {item:Distilling Machine} to get {item:Grave Flower Extract}. In the Edron academy there is an Alchemical Apparatus in {npc:Sinclair}'s laboratory, in the central tower (on the **north** side of the room). There are Distilling Machines in Liberty Bay, for example.
If a device does not react, try another Alchemical Apparatus or a Distilling Machine.
Using the Grave Flower on the machine
Use the {item:Bone Meal} on the {item:Grave Flower Extract}: you get a {item:Vial with a Skull Cork}.
Use the {item:Vial with a Skull Cork} to drink the potion. With the potion drunk and the three bells rung, you can now go through the invisible portal next to {npc:Para Norbert}.
4. Drain the Brain — Brain Grounds: tissue samples and souls

Go back to {npc:Para Norbert}: from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Venore ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and from there you walk **west**. Next to him is the invisible portal to the {wiki:Brain Grounds}: it looks like **sand**. Step into it.
Para Norbert and the invisible portal
Going down to the blocked area
Go down **2 floors** until you find an area you cannot enter yet. That is enough to advance the mission.
Watch out for the yellow ground ({wiki:Slime Fungus}): every now and then it takes a percentage of your maximum health as earth damage, growing larger as you go down (**15%**, **20%** and **25%**).
Go back the same way, climbing the floors to the point where you arrived, and leave the way you came in to return to {npc:Para Norbert} (the wiki does not describe another exit).
Talk to {npc:Para Norbert} and report. He gives you a {item:Scalpel} and asks you for **20 tissue samples** ({item:Ulcer Probe|Ulcer Probes}) from the ground that hurts you, the *ulcer*.

In the Brain Grounds (on any floor), walk over the *ulcer* (the yellow ground) until you take damage. Right after, a small bubble appears on a square: use the {item:Scalpel} on that square to take a sample. Repeat **20 times**.
The ulcer: use the Scalpel on the square with the bubble
Effect of the Brain Grounds floor
Leave the Brain Grounds as before and hand the 20 samples to {npc:Para Norbert}. He gives you a {item:Purifier for Lost Souls} and asks you for **20 purified souls**.

Kill the Brain Grounds creatures ({creature:Flimsy Lost Soul|Flimsy}, {creature:Mean Lost Soul|Mean} and {creature:Freakish Lost Soul|Freakish Lost Souls}) and loot {item:Lost Soul (Item)|Lost Souls}. Use each one on the {item:Purifier for Lost Souls} to get a {item:Purified Soul (Netherworld)|Purified Soul}. You need **20**.
Each purification has a **25%** chance of failing: gather more than 20 Lost Souls.
You can get Lost Souls from other players, but you have to purify them yourself.
Leave the Brain Grounds and hand the purified souls to {npc:Para Norbert}. From now on you can enter the fight against {creature:Brain Head}.
Before you go to the boss, take the chance to make the {item:Burial Shroud} (section 6): it is all in the Brain Grounds.
{creature:Brain Head} can be faced by a team of **up to 5 players** and you have **5 minutes** to kill it.
**Ice** (the boss is very weak to ice)
**Energy** (heals the boss); according to the boss page, **fire** also heals it

Enter the {wiki:Brain Grounds} again through the portal next to {npc:Para Norbert} and go down to the area that was previously blocked, 2 floors below: after you hand in the souls, access to the fight is open. The {creature:Cerebellum} and {creature:Bad Thought|Bad Thoughts} in the boss room only exist in the Brain Grounds, so the fight is there (only the Brain Head page says Netherworld).
There are several {creature:Cerebellum} in the room. Before focusing on the boss, kill the one in the **north-east** and then the ones around Brain Head. That is usually enough.
With those Cerebellum dead, focus on {creature:Brain Head} with **ice** damage. The team can use {item:Poison Bomb Rune|Poison Bomb Runes} to keep the {creature:Bad Thought|Bad Thoughts} away.
The Bad Thoughts' energy attack hits a 2-square radius around the target and **heals Brain Head** if he is within range.
If you do not kill him within 5 minutes, you are teleported out of the room and can only try again **20 hours** later.
Reporting and accepting the next mission

Leave the Brain Grounds the same way and report to {npc:Para Norbert}: the Drain the Brain mission is complete. Right after, he asks for your help again — answer {key:yes} to receive the **Journey to the Netherworld** mission.
To enter the Netherworld you need to wear a Burial Shroud. You can make it earlier, during the tasks of section 4 (even before you accept this mission).
In the {wiki:Brain Grounds}, go to the far **south-east** and use the {item:Stump}: you receive {item:Yarn}.
Using the Stump to get Yarn
Follow the cave **north**. Around the centre you find a pool of {wiki:Ghostly Water}: use the {item:Yarn} on it and it turns into {item:Glittering Yarn}.

Go down **1 floor** and go to the far **south-west**, where there is a {item:Loom}. Use the {item:Glittering Yarn} on the loom to get the {item:Burial Shroud}. Then leave the Brain Grounds the way you came.
The Loom on the floor below
7. Journey to the Netherworld — three more bells (Edron, Yalahar, Ankrahmun)
With the mission accepted, ring the {item:Death Knell} again at these three places.
Summary of the second round of bells:
Next to the pool of blood, 4 floors below ground
Ground floor, on the east side
6th floor of the tomb, on the east side

Take a boat to **Edron**: from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 40 gp). You arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. The {wiki:Edron Vampire Crypt} is **north** of the city: go in through the small entrance cave and go down.
Go down to the floor with the pool of blood (the wiki calls it the 3rd floor of the crypt; it is 4 floors below ground) and ring the {item:Death Knell} next to the pool.
On the same floor there is a teleport that takes you to the Stone Blocks next to the cave entrance. From there go up the entrance path to the surface and return to Edron, heading **south**.
Stone Blocks next to the entrance

There is no direct boat from Edron to **Yalahar**: take the magic carpet with {npc:Pino} to Darashia ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}, 40 gp) and there {npc:Petros} takes you to Yalahar ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}, 210 gp). There are also boats to Yalahar from Thais ({npc:Captain Bluebear}) and Ankrahmun ({npc:Captain Sinbeard}). You arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Karith}. Go **north** to the city centre and enter the **Magician Quarter**, whose gate has no mechanism. Inside, talk to the guard {npc:Reed}, between the Magician Quarter and the Cemetery Quarter: say {key:hi}, {key:pass} and then the name of the destination quarter (the Cemetery Quarter). If you already have access to the Cemetery Quarter mechanism (In Service of Yalahar), you can also use it.
On the **ground floor**, on the **east** side of the Cemetery Quarter, ring the {item:Death Knell} at the coordinate spot.
Stay on the roads: {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares} can attack you over the fence, and the quarter has {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and {creature:Grim Reaper|Grim Reapers}.

Go back to {npc:Reed} and say {key:pass} and the name of the Magician Quarter; from there return to the centre and the harbour. To continue to Ankrahmun: {npc:Karith} takes you if you have the In Service of Yalahar routes; otherwise, {npc:Captain Cookie}, on the boat next to him, takes you to Liberty Bay (400 gp) or Thais (800 gp); from Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you to Ankrahmun ({key:ankrahmun}, 90 gp).

In **Ankrahmun** you land next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}. Leave the city by the **north-east** ramp and follow the walls **south**: the {wiki:Shadow Tomb} entrance is in the desert south-east of the city. Use the {item:Shovel} at the coordinate spot to open the hole and go down.
Go down through the tomb to the **6th floor** (6 floors below the desert). There, go **east** to the coordinate spot and ring the {item:Death Knell}.
The tomb has fire creatures ({creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}), {creature:Vampire|Vampires} and creatures that turn invisible.

Go back the same way to the start of the tomb and climb up through the hole you opened, using the {item:Rope}. Return to Ankrahmun via the **north-east** ramp: {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
8. Journey to the Netherworld — the Netherworld and the three minibosses (solo)
In the Netherworld you kill three minibosses **alone**. They hit hard (combos of up to 2000 health in one turn) and have a strong Mana Drain.

Take a boat to **Port Hope**: from Ankrahmun, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}, 80 gp); from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} (150 gp). Cross the Tiquanda jungle **north-east** to {wiki:Banuta}. The {wiki:Netherworld} entrance is just **east** of Banuta: like the Brain Grounds portal, it is invisible and can only be spotted by a small wall.
Equip the {item:Burial Shroud} in place of your armour and step on the earth next to the small wall. Once inside, you can put your armour back on.
Without the Burial Shroud on, you cannot get in.
To move from one area to the next, use the special squares with a skull drawn on them: they work as teleports. Look for the portal of each of the three minibosses.
The Netherworld is full of {creature:Flimsy Lost Soul|Flimsy}, {creature:Mean Lost Soul|Mean} and {creature:Freakish Lost Soul|Freakish Lost Souls}.
Kill all three, each one **alone** (each has a 20 h cooldown):
What works best against these minibosses:
{item:Envenomed Arrow|Envenomed Arrows}: the bosses are very resistant to physical damage
**Earth** and **ice** waves, taking care not to run out of mana
**Fire** and **energy** waves, taking care not to run out of mana

For every vocation except Knights it helps a lot to drag the bosses over some {item:Fire Wall Rune|Fire Walls}. According to the boss pages, all three are immune to death, take only half physical damage and are slightly weak to ice; Irgix and Vok take no energy damage (Unaz takes half).

The minibosses can drop {item:Skull Coin|Skull Coins}: pick them up, because you will need **three** for {npc:The Thaian}. In the wiki's loot statistics the Skull Coin shows low rates (about 9% from Unaz, 6% from Irgix and 3% from Vok); if you are short of any, the Skull Coin is tradeable on the Market.
Do not sell them to NPCs (they pay 12 000 gp each): you need 3.

Go back through the skull squares to where you arrived and leave the way you came in, east of Banuta (the wiki does not describe another exit). Then cross the jungle **south-west** to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to **Venore**, the closest city to Para Norbert ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}, 160 gp).
If you cannot find the exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} sends you to your city's temple; it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block.
From Venore, walk **west** to {npc:Para Norbert} and hand in the Journey to the Netherworld mission. Next comes the Thaian part.
9. The Thaian — Spectulus and the tavern
This part requires the {wiki:Sea of Light Quest}.

Go to **Edron** (from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}) and go up to the top floor of the central tower of the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|academy}, where {npc:Spectulus} is. Say {key:hi} and ask him about {key:The Thaian}.
Leave Edron heading **north**: {npc:The Thaian}'s tavern is in the forest north of the mountain. To return to Edron, do the route in reverse, heading **south**.
Say {key:hi}, then {key:need} and answer {key:yes} twice. He asks you to ring the {item:Death Knell} at three more places.
10. The Thaian — the last three bells (Issavi, Ramoa, Lion's Rock)
Summary of the third round of bells:
Go down the hole inside the Water Temple
Where the Cavebears appear, near the dragon skeleton

Travel to **Issavi**. From Edron, the simplest option is {npc:Pino}'s magic carpet ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}, 100 gp), which drops you at the Issavi carpet. There are also boats from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** and **Oramond** ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}), which arrive at {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat, in the harbour north of the city. The {wiki:Kilmaresh Catacombs} are beneath the **west** side of Issavi: go to the **Water Temple** and go down the hole inside it.
Just below the hole (1 floor below ground), ring the {item:Death Knell} at the coordinate spot.
The catacombs are a hideout of the Fafnar cultists, a hunting place for level 300+.

Climb up the same hole (bring a {item:Rope}) and return to Issavi. {npc:Captain Harava} takes you by boat to Venore, Darashia, Krailos or Oramond, and the Issavi carpet takes you to Darashia (40 gp) or Edron (60 gp).

Go to **Liberty Bay**: from Issavi, take {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat or the carpet to **Darashia**, where {npc:Petros} takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 200 gp); from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} also goes there (170 gp). At Liberty Bay harbour, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you to Goroma: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). You land on the **east** coast of {wiki:Goroma}; walk **west** to the stairs of the {wiki:Teleportation Hub}, go down and enter the **right-hand** teleport, which leads to Ramoa.
In Goroma there is only the right-hand teleport (it is the first in the chain). You can only use it after doing {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} up to access to Ramoa.
Going down to the Lich Hell

The bell is rung **beneath Ramoa**, where the {creature:Undead Cavebear|Undead Cavebears} appear, near a dragon skeleton. These bears appear in the {wiki:Lich Hell}, a level of the Ramoa dungeon, on the same floor and right next to the bell spot (bear location: {coord:31948,32578,10}). Follow the maps: on each one you enter at the red circle and walk to the blue one; on the last one, use the {item:Pick} on the earth around the blue circle to open the hole to the Lich Hell.
Path to the Lich Hell (3/3): open the hole with the Pick
The Lich Hell has {creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}.
Ring the {item:Death Knell} next to the dragon skeleton, at the coordinate spot.

Go back the same way (bring a {item:Rope} to climb out of the hole) to the Ramoa Teleportation Hub and enter the **left-hand** teleport, which leads to Goroma. Go up the stairs, head **east** to {npc:Jack Fate}'s ship and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.

Go to **Darashia**: from Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}, 200 gp); from Edron, take the magic carpet with {npc:Pino} ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}, 40 gp). Head **west-north-west** to {wiki:Lion's Rock}, go down into the cave and go through the {item:Mystic Flame} on the **west** side of the first underground floor to enter the sanctuary (you can only pass if you have done the trials of the {wiki:Lion's Rock Quest}).
Right after the sanctuary entrance, ring the {item:Death Knell} at the coordinate spot.
Lion's Rock, past the sanctuary entrance (bell 9)
On the lower floors there are {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} (they paralyse) and {creature:Roaring Lion|Roaring Lions}.

Go back through the {item:Mystic Flame} and along the cave path to the surface and return to Darashia, heading **east-south-east**. To get back to Edron, talk to {npc:Chemar}, on the Darashia carpet platform: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}.

Go back to {npc:The Thaian}'s tavern, north of Edron, and talk to him as you did the first time ({key:hi}, {key:need}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}; the wiki records no other words for this hand-in). Also hand him the **3 {item:Skull Coin|Skull Coins}** you looted in the Netherworld. From here on you can enter the Barren Drift.
11. The Thaian — Barren Drift and the Eye of the Chasm
Element tips for the Barren Drift and the boss:
The {wiki:Barren Drift} cave is inside the mountain right next to {npc:The Thaian}'s tavern. Use a {item:Small Sapphire} on the wall of the rock formation to enter.

{creature:Evil Prospector|Evil Prospectors} and {creature:Cursed Prospector|Cursed Prospectors} keep their distance but have two strong attacks. The energy ball on the target seems to hit harder when it catches several players: do not stand together. They also have a *parry* attack that hits very hard: the more creatures you hit with area damage, the more damage you can take. They also reflect **earth** damage.
Kill them one by one when needed. Mages can use {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes}: these creatures are weak to death.

Use a {item:Pick} (or an equivalent secret agent tool) on the {item:Large Luminescent Crystal|Large Luminescent Crystals} in the walls to get {item:Luminescent Crystal|Luminescent Crystals}. Each time you receive 1, 5 or 10. You can walk around the cave or stay in the same spot: the crystals respawn quite quickly.
Large Luminescent Crystals in the walls of the Barren Drift
Mining triggers raids of {creature:Evil Prospector|Evil Prospectors}: the more crystals are mined, the more raids can happen. With many players doing the quest at the same time, be extra careful.

With at least **100** {item:Luminescent Crystal|Luminescent Crystals}, go **straight** back to {npc:The Thaian}, by the shortest path to the tavern. Say {key:hi}, {key:need}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} to hand them in.
If you walk **south**, the crystals disappear.
Go back to the cave and keep mining. If all went well, after a few attempts you are teleported to a small room.
If you reach 50 crystals without being teleported, hand them in to The Thaian again and go back to mining.

In the small room, get ready to face {creature:Cursed Prospector|Cursed Prospectors} and {creature:Evil Prospector|Evil Prospectors}. Use the large crystal: you melt it, receive a {item:Raw Eye of the Chasm} and are immediately teleported out, **south** of the room, where the creatures appear.
Leaving the Barren Drift and going back to the Thaian

Leave the cave the way you came in (the rock formation portal) and go back to {npc:The Thaian}'s tavern. As soon as you greet him ({key:hi}), you are automatically sent to the lever room for the boss fight.

In the lever room, gather the team (up to 5 players) and use the lever to go in. First kill the Prospectors in the cave. When they are all dead, the room changes its look and {creature:Thaian's Ghost} appears, with more Prospectors. Killing the Ghost deals **5000 drown damage** to {creature:Thaian}. Repeat until the boss dies.
According to the boss page, Thaian only takes 10% of the damage of any element: the damage that counts comes from the Ghosts.
You have **10 minutes**. If the team fails, you are teleported out of the cave and The Thaian only sends you back to the boss room **20 hours** later.
Like every boss in the quest, Thaian has a 20-hour cooldown.

When you kill {creature:Thaian} you receive the achievement **Prospectre**. The wiki does not describe how to leave the boss room after the victory: look for the room's exit and, once in the {wiki:Barren Drift}, go back through the portal you came in by, which leads to the rock formation next to the tavern, north of Edron.
If you cannot find the exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} sends you to your city's temple; it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block.
Go back to Edron (heading **south**), go up to the top floor of the academy's central tower to {npc:Spectulus} and say {key:Thaian} to tell him what you discovered.
13. Zarganash — getting there and the three minibosses
The final part takes place in Zarganash, reached through an invisible teleport in Vengoth. First you kill 3 minibosses with teams of up to 5 players; the final boss allows up to 10.

Take a boat to **Yalahar**. There is no direct boat from Edron: take the carpet with {npc:Pino} to Darashia ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}) and there {npc:Petros} takes you to Yalahar ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}, 210 gp); there are also boats from Thais and Ankrahmun. At the **Trade Quarter** docks (straight **south** from the main gate), talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He drops you off in the **west** of {wiki:Vengoth}.
Walk **north-east** to the invisible teleport to {wiki:Zarganash}, at the coordinate spot, and step into it. Use the map to reach each miniboss and the final battle.
Map of Zarganash: path to each miniboss and the final boss
The three minibosses can drop {item:Soulforged Lantern|Soulforged Lanterns} (they remove the Hex at the final boss) and {item:Death Toll|Death Tolls} (you need 2 for the labyrinth). Keep them all.

{creature:The Unwelcome} takes almost no direct damage and uses {wiki:Lifesteal}: pull it away from the other creatures and from the team. The room is large: put the team next to the **west** wall and leave the boss on the **east** side (that way Druids can also use {spell:Terra Wave}). Attack {creature:Brother Worm}, which appears and disappears repeatedly in the **centre** of the room: the damage to it is what hurts the boss. Keep going until The Unwelcome dies.
The {creature:Wormling|Wormlings} spawn non-stop and, when they die, explode for **750 earth damage** in a 2-square radius. It isn't much, but several dying at the same time can kill careless mages.

In {creature:The Dread Maiden}'s room there are coloured ghosts: {creature:Red Soul Stealer}, {creature:Green Soul Stealer} and {creature:Blue Soul Stealer}. They make the boss stronger, so you have to get rid of them: lure each ghost into a **vortex of the same colour** and it disappears.
If a Soul Stealer passes through a vortex of **another** colour, it deals area damage or heals the boss.

The ghosts only change target with {spell:Challenge}. The blocker should immediately take the Dread Maiden to the **north-east** corner of the room and keep her there while the shooters deal with the ghosts. A second Knight, a Paladin or {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} help to trap her. Keep attacking the boss: at first she is immune and then takes very little damage, but as the fight goes on she takes more and dies easily.

He is the most dangerous of the three. In {creature:The Fear Feaster}'s room there are also {creature:Horror|Horrors} (jesters), {creature:Phobia|Phobias} (tarantulas) and {creature:Fear|Fears} (blightwalkers). Start with the Phobias, which are easy. The Horrors heal each other and the boss, but they attack from range and the shooters can handle them (mages, careful: their damage is considerable); as long as they don't attack the blocker, you don't need to kill them. The Fear can be blocked together with the boss.
According to the boss's page, death damage heals the Fear Feaster: avoid it.

About **30 seconds** after the start, the team is teleported to a small room with the {creature:Symbol of Fear}. It is a stationary totem, but everyone in the room takes ever-increasing **death** damage: destroy it quickly to return to the main room. This repeats a few times until the Fear Feaster dies.
The longer you stay in the Symbol of Fear room, the more damage you take.
14. Zarganash — the labyrinth and The Pale Worm
After the 3 minibosses you can move on to the final boss. Before the lever room there is still a labyrinth.

To enter the labyrinth you need to have **2** {item:Death Toll|Death Tolls} in your inventory. They are used up when you enter the **green** or **red** vortices. They drop from the Lost Souls and from all the quest's bosses (solo and team).

The goal is to cross the labyrinth without being sent back to the entrance. You go back to the start if you step on **Ghost Webs**, if you suffer the *death-berserk* of the {creature:Empty|Empties} (ghosts; they deal no damage) or if you walk over the energy barriers, which always appear and disappear in the same places. The {creature:Innocent Soul|Innocent Souls} (white ghosts) draw the Empties' attention: make use of them.
Make good use of the Innocent Souls
If you make a mistake, you go back to the entrance
Every time you go back to the entrance you spend more Death Tolls.

Send the mages first: inside they can summon {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, which the ghosts end up attacking without being able to kill them, and the path becomes easier for the others. Give all the Death Tolls to the same player, who should go through **last**: that way nobody is left without tolls at the entrance while those who already got through have tolls to spare.
The exit to the lever room
The Greater Hex and the Soulforged Lantern

After the labyrinth you reach the lever room: gather the team (up to 10 players) and go in. On entering the boss room, **everyone** gets {wiki:Hexed|Greater Hex}: you deal less damage, receive less healing and your total health is set to **40%** of the maximum. Using a {item:Soulforged Lantern} removes the Hex for the whole fight (once removed it is not applied again). The same lantern can be used by several players, but it has a **20%** chance of breaking on each use; even when it breaks, the effect is applied.
The lantern may break, but the effect is applied anyway
The lantern is essential for Knights and Paladins, but not for mages. Unless they have spare lanterns, mages should not use them: save them for other players on other attempts.
Greed Worms and the Hunger Worm
In the room are {creature:The Pale Worm} and several {creature:Greed Worm|Greed Worms}. Gather them and keep attacking until the {creature:Hunger Worm} appears.
Just like The Unwelcome's Wormlings, the Greed Worms deal **750 earth damage** when they die. Here there are many of them and several can die at the same time.

Kill the {creature:Hunger Worm}: a hole appears where it dies. The whole team should go down **immediately**, preferably a Knight or Paladin first. You have about **10 seconds** before the hole disappears; anyone left behind has to wait in the main room with the boss and the Greed Worms.

In the room below are {creature:A Weak Spot} and more Greed Worms. Attack the Weak Spot: the damage it takes is passed on to The Pale Worm (they share health). Players in this room take ever-increasing **death** damage, so stay only **10 to 15 seconds** and leave by the ramp before the damage gets too high (you can usually stay until the damage jumps from about 1000 to 2000).
Don't stay too long in the Weak Spot room.

Repeat the cycle (Hunger Worm, hole, Weak Spot, ramp) until {creature:The Pale Worm} dies. You have **25 minutes**, much more than you need with a team of 10. When you win you **automatically** receive the {wiki:Poltergeist Outfits|Poltergeist} outfit.

The wiki does not describe the way out: go back the way you came to the teleport you entered through and exit to Vengoth. There, walk **south-west** to {npc:Harlow} and say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp) to return to Yalahar's Trade Quarter.
If you cannot find the exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} sends you to your city's temple; it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block.

Go back to {npc:Para Norbert}, north of the Jakundaf Desert. In Yalahar, {npc:Karith} takes you to Venore if you have the In Service of Yalahar routes; otherwise, {npc:Captain Cookie} takes you to Thais (800 gp) or Liberty Bay (400 gp), and from Liberty Bay {npc:Jack Fate} takes you to Venore. From Venore walk **west** (from Thais, **east**). Report to him to complete the quest and receive the achievement **Beyonder**.

Outfit addons: see the {wiki:Poltergeist Outfits Quest} (uses a {item:Spooky Hood} and a {item:Ghost Claw}). The full outfit gives the achievement **Mainstreet Nightmare**. Both items drop rarely from {creature:Brain Head}, {creature:The Unwelcome}, {creature:The Dread Maiden} and {creature:The Fear Feaster} and can also be bought on the Market.
All the bosses (including The Pale Worm) have a 20-hour cooldown and can be repeated after the quest, for loot.
On the 2nd floor of the Brain Grounds there is a portal to the Netherworld ({coord:31904,32347,9}), used by those who hunt in both areas.
The Netherworld and Zarganash are different areas, even though some NPCs say they are the same place.

Rare loot from The Pale Worm includes {item:Spectral Scrap of Cloth}, {item:Pale Worm's Scalp}, {item:Ravenous Circlet}, {item:Fabulous Legs}, {item:Phantasmal Axe}, {item:Pair of Nightmare Boots} and {item:Ring of Souls}.
